description: The app-chrome overlays of SvGrid UI in Svelte 5: SvDrawer, an edge side-sheet with a configurable side and title, SvContextMenu for a right-click menu from an items array, and the toast() API with SvToaster for notifications. All are built on the shared focus-trap, scroll-lock and dismissable-layer primitives, so nested overlays close top-first and every toast is announced to screen readers.

faq.question: How do I show a toast?
faq.answer: Render SvToaster once, then call toast('Saved') from anywhere, or toast.success, toast.error, toast.warning and toast.info with an optional duration where 0 keeps it sticky; toast.promise wraps an async call with loading, success and error messages.

faq.question: What does the dismissable layer stack do?
faq.answer: It tracks open overlays in order so Escape or an outside click closes only the topmost one, which keeps a context menu inside a drawer behaving correctly.

faq.question: How is the drawer opened?
faq.answer: Bind open and set it true; side chooses the edge, the drawer traps focus, locks scroll and closes on Escape or the backdrop.
